title: __restrict__ pointer mapping for array arguments and alias analysis optimization

details.current_behavior: Mapping C# array arguments (T[]) to C++ pointers T* __restrict__.
details.strategy: Applying the __restrict__ keyword promotes NVCC's alias analysis optimization and maximizes L1 cache and register utilization efficiency.

title: Skipping zero-initialization generation of C++ local variables via the [SkipLocalsInit] attribute

details.current_behavior: Normally, C# local variables generate zero-initialization code via = on the C++ side, but this is skipped if the [SkipLocalsInit] attribute is applied.
details.strategy: Detects attributes at the method, type, and module levels to suppress generation via the TranspileContext.SkipLocalsInit flag.

details.current_behavior: Directly maps [GpuInline] and [GpuNoInline] attributes on C# methods to CUDA's __forceinline__ and __noinline__ compiler directives.
details.strategy: Scans attributes during method signature generation to switch C++ prefixes.

title: Immediately Invoked Function Expressions (IIFE) for preventing value swap destruction in tuple assignments

details.current_behavior: For swap assignments like (a, b) = (b, a), a simple expansion to C++ destroys the value on the right side due to the assignment on the left side.
details.strategy: Generates an IIFE [&]() { auto _t0 = b; auto _t1 = a; a = _t0; b = _t1; }() to protect values with temporary variables.

title: Ensuring initialization safety of struct creation (new Struct) via Immediately Invoked Function Expressions (IIFE)

details.current_behavior: To safely evaluate creation expressions with initializers like new Struct { A = 1 } in C++.
details.strategy: Expands scope-isolated IIFEs like [&]() { Struct _tmp; _tmp.A = 1; return _tmp; }() to match C# side effects and evaluation order.

title: Automatic generation of alignof(T) boundary alignment macros for dynamic SharedMemory<T>

details.current_behavior: Prevents Misaligned Access violations (memory access exceptions) when allocating multiple types to the dynamic shared memory extern __shared__ char __gsharp_dynamic_smem[].
details.strategy: Memory allocator architecture that auto-generates safe byte offset calculations __smem_offset = (__smem_offset + align - 1) & ~(align - 1); using alignof(T).

title: Static C++ array expansion for constant size SharedMemory<T>

details.current_behavior: When a constant is passed, such as SharedMemory<T> smem = new(256);, it is expanded as a static-sized shared memory.
details.strategy: Converts to static C++ declarations like __shared__ T smem[256];, eliminating dynamic offset calculations at runtime.

title: Transpiling C# 12 [InlineArray] attribute to C++ fixed-length arrays

details.current_behavior: Maps C# structs with [InlineArray] applied to C++ fixed-length array fields (T field[N]).
details.strategy: Simultaneously auto-generates operator[](int index) and const operator[](int index) const to achieve seamless index access and memory layout matching in C++.

title: Topological sorting of C++ struct forward declarations considering dependencies

details.current_behavior: C++ cannot hold an undefined struct as a value type field, so declaring structs out of order like in C# results in compilation errors.
details.strategy: StructTranspiler.GetTopologicallySortedStructs topologically sorts the dependency graph of used structs to generate C++ declarations in the correct order.

title: Mapping of implicit operator to C++ implicit constructors

details.strategy: Automatically expands to C++ constructors with arguments if casting to a target struct, or to operator T() const conversion operators if casting to a different type.
